name: Nexa AI Product Content SmartSuite for WooCommerce
author: nexaplugins

sections.description:
Nexa AI Product Content SmartSuite for WooCommerce is your smart AI assistant for generating product content that sells. Whether you’re launching new products or optimizing existing ones, this plugin helps WooCommerce store owners and marketers automatically generate:

  • Product Titles
  • Product Short Descriptions
  • Product Long Descriptions
  • Product Tags
  • Product FAQs

All powered by state-of-the-art AI technology.

Why use Nexa AI?

  • Save hours of manual content writing
  • Improve product discoverability and SEO
  • Generate tailored content for each product in seconds
  • Bulk content generation support
  • Fully integrated with WooCommerce admin

Pro Version Available: The Pro version supports bulk product processing, license activation, advanced customization, and premium support. Learn more

Features

  • 🔹 AI-powered generation of product content
  • 🔹 Bulk product content generation (Pro)
  • 🔹 Intelligent product filter for targeting specific products
  • 🔹 Edit and regenerate individual fields as needed
  • 🔹 One-click apply to update WooCommerce product data
  • 🔹 Compatible with all product types
  • 🔹 Integrated seamlessly with the WordPress admin
  • 🔹 Lightweight and developer-friendly

External Services

This plugin connects to the official OpenAI API to generate AI-powered product content for WooCommerce.

It sends the following data to OpenAI:
– Prompt text derived from product details (e.g., product name, category, attributes)
– Selected AI model (e.g., gpt-3.5-turbo or gpt-4)
– Generation parameters such as temperature, max tokens, and content type

The plugin communicates with the following API endpoints:
– https://platform.openai.com/account/api-keys (API key management)
– https://api.openai.com/v1/models (List available models)
– https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions (Generate AI content)

All API communication is securely handled over HTTPS. The plugin does not store or transmit any sensitive customer information or personal data to OpenAI.

External Service Provider: OpenAI
– Website: https://www.openai.com
– API Access: https://platform.openai.com
– Terms of Service: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use
– Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later. See http://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/nexa-ai-product-content-smartsuite-for-woocommerce-lite directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Nexa AI SmartSuite to start generating product content.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin use OpenAI or ChatGPT?

Yes. The plugin integrates with OpenAI’s GPT-based models to generate content.

Is an API key required?

Yes. You’ll need to provide your OpenAI API key in the plugin settings.

Can I use this with variable or custom product types?

Yes, it works with all standard WooCommerce product types.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes. The Pro version includes advanced filters, bulk scheduling, license key management, and enhanced AI capabilities. Visit nexaplugins.com for details.

Will the AI overwrite my existing product content?

No. You have full control — content is only updated when you explicitly apply it.
